messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD_GATEWAY_5XX - inference-gateway (us-west-2). 5xx rate jumped from ~12% -> 28% in the last 3m. Auto-page to oncall rotation + escalation. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx

olivia-oncall: acked, taking point. checking dashboards now. any immediate customer-facing failures?

arjun: looking at traces — keepalive resets upstream, a lot of 502/504. aggregating logs to confirm root.

emily: top three customers by error volume right now: corp-analytics, shopflow, notifier-saas. corp-analytics shows heavy retries.

miguel: quick mitigation suggestion: shift routing weight off us-west-2 -> us-east-1 by 20%. can push traffic now.

olivia-oncall: +1 to routing shift. also prepping plan B = rollback recent edge-proxy config if shift doesn't help.

sarah: initiating canary rollback on edge-proxy (v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0) for the affected AZs. command: `/deploy rollback service=edge-proxy target=canary`

arjun: logs snippet showing pattern:
```
[2024-06-21T02:12:03Z] upstream keepalive reset, conn closed, code=502, req_id=abc123
[2024-06-21T02:12:04Z] upstream keepalive reset, conn closed, code=502, req_id=abc124
```
Looks like upstream connection resets correlate with spikes.

incidentbot: PagerDuty update: olivia-oncall acknowledged at 1742101242. Escalation timer reset. If unresolved, PD will escalate to SRE lead at +15m.

miguel: routing change pushed. updating weights: us-west-2 60% -> 40%, us-east-1 +20%. verifying in console.

emily: checking metrics — 5xx rate down to ~18% in the last minute, p95 latency stable. still occasional 502s but trending down.

olivia-oncall: please notify #support and inform affected accounts (corp-analytics + shopflow). @emily can you draft a quick blurb? I'll capture timeline.

arjun: saw an edge-proxy config rollout at 1742100800: `conn_reuse=false -> true` by ci-bot, rolled to 40% ~30m ago. could be contributing to keepalive behavior.

sarah: canary rollback completed, no regression observed. holding for 5m before promoting.

emily: brief status for support: "We observed an elevated 5xx error rate affecting a subset of gateway requests. We've shifted traffic away from the impacted region and rolled back a recent proxy change. Errors are decreasing; monitoring continues."

olivia-oncall: excellent. current 5xx ~4% over last 2m. customer impact limited to intermittent failures for a few heavy customers; most retries succeed.

incidentbot: Mitigation note: incident mitigated flag set by olivia-oncall at 1742101340. PagerDuty incident resolved.

olivia-oncall: thanks everyone — great response. creating INC-5678 for RCA/postmortem and SLO impact. please add follow-ups to that ticket. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
